stylePrompt: Use the declared styleFamily for each item and choose subjects from people, communities, animals, plants, landscapes, weather, tools, vehicles, buildings and everyday objects according to the scene. Keep one coherent style inside each image while varying styles across the batch. Shared constraints: mature learner-facing art direction, landscape 3:2 composition, a clear focal action or relationship, no in-image teaching text, and no live-action or realistic-human impression. When people appear, every readable foreground or midground face must have clearly rendered natural eyes, a nose, a mouth and a scene-appropriate expression. Never use blank oval faces, featureless masks, mannequin heads or shadows that erase the facial features. Vary age, skin tone, facial structure, body type, hairstyle, clothing, ability and occupation naturally. No realistic skin pores, photographic faces, stock-photo staging, logos, watermarks, readable interfaces, chibi proportions or glossy toy rendering.

items.sentenceEn: Every morning, Lin swims across the quiet lake before breakfast.
items.sentenceZh: 每天早晨，林都会在早餐前游过宁静的湖面。
items.scene: At dawn on a misty West Lake, an adult swimmer in a bright cap moves steadily through calm water toward a small stone bridge while lotus leaves frame the foreground.
items.altText: 清晨，一名戴泳帽的人游过有荷叶和石桥的湖面。

items.sentenceEn: The mechanic replaced the flat tire beside the country road.
items.sentenceZh: 机械师在乡间公路旁换掉了瘪轮胎。
items.scene: A roadside mechanic kneels beside a small car, holding a new black tire upright while the removed flat tire lies visibly collapsed near an open tool case.
items.altText: 路边的机械师正在为汽车更换瘪掉的轮胎。

items.sentenceEn: The cracked cable was the fault that stopped the machine.
items.sentenceZh: 这根破裂的电缆就是让机器停转的故障。
items.scene: Inside a workshop, a technician points from a silent machine to one clearly cracked power cable, visually tracing the single cause of the breakdown without labels or text.
items.altText: 技术员指出导致机器停转的一根破裂电缆。

items.sentenceEn: A loose button hung from his coat by a single thread.
items.sentenceZh: 一颗松动的纽扣只靠一根线挂在他的外套上。
items.scene: A close view of an adult fastening a winter coat shows one button dangling conspicuously from a single slack thread, contrasted with the other firmly attached buttons.
items.altText: 外套上一颗松动的纽扣仅由一根线悬挂着。

items.sentenceEn: The train will arrive shortly, so the travelers gather their bags.
items.sentenceZh: 火车很快就会到站，所以旅客们收拾好行李。
items.scene: On a platform, two adult travelers lift their bags as a distant train rounds the bend and grows near, creating a clear sense that arrival is only moments away.
items.altText: 旅客收拾行李，远处的火车即将驶入站台。

items.sentenceEn: The old courtyard was originally a family home.
items.sentenceZh: 这座老院子最初是一处民居。
items.scene: A restored Beijing courtyard is shown with a subtle visual echo of its earlier life: present-day visitors stand at the edge while a warm translucent memory shows a family sharing tea there long ago.
items.altText: 北京老院子中浮现出它最初作为民居时的家庭生活。

items.sentenceEn: The volunteers collected a considerable amount of food for the shelter.
items.sentenceZh: 志愿者们为收容所募集了相当多的食物。
items.scene: Several adult volunteers stand beside a long, densely filled arrangement of food boxes and produce, with the large donation dominating the composition and an almost empty starting crate nearby.
items.altText: 志愿者站在大量捐赠食物和装满物资的箱子旁。

items.sentenceEn: Prior experience helped Maya repair the camera quickly.
items.sentenceZh: 先前的经验帮助玛雅迅速修好了相机。
items.scene: At a repair bench, an experienced adult calmly fixes a camera while a layered memory fragment behind her shows the same hands practicing on an older camera years earlier.
items.altText: 玛雅凭借先前修相机的经验迅速完成维修。

items.sentenceEn: The intellectual spent the evening comparing difficult ideas.
items.sentenceZh: 这位知识分子用整个晚上比较复杂的思想。
items.scene: A thoughtful middle-aged scholar sits between two contrasting stacks of symbolic diagrams and open books, weighing their ideas with an alert expression in a dramatic carved-line study.
items.altText: 一位学者在书房中比较两组复杂思想。

items.sentenceEn: The stone walls protected the village from the assault.
items.sentenceZh: 石墙保护村庄免受袭击。
items.scene: A non-graphic historical scene shows villagers safely behind sturdy stone walls as a distant attacking force is stopped outside the closed gate, emphasizing defense and protection rather than injury.
items.altText: 坚固石墙挡住远处的进攻，保护墙内村民。

items.meaningZh: 放松；松懈；松弛；变从容；休息；休
items.sentenceEn: After the long hike, they relax beside a mountain stream.
items.sentenceZh: 长途徒步之后，他们在山间溪流旁放松休息。
items.scene: Two adult hikers rest comfortably beside a clear stream in a Huangshan-inspired valley, shoes loosened and shoulders relaxed beneath pine trees and layered misty peaks.
items.altText: 两名徒步者在黄山风格的溪流和松树旁放松休息。

items.sentenceEn: A red lantern rested on the third stair from the bottom.
items.sentenceZh: 一盏红灯笼放在从下往上数的第三级台阶上。
items.scene: In an old Chinese lane, a stone staircase rises clearly from the foreground; one red lantern sits precisely on the third visible step from the bottom, with no other lanterns on the stairs.
items.altText: 中国老巷的石楼梯上，一盏红灯笼位于从下数第三级。

items.sentenceEn: Crossing the rope bridge became the greatest adventure of their trip.
items.sentenceZh: 穿过绳桥成了他们旅途中最精彩的冒险。
items.scene: Two adult travelers carefully cross a high rope bridge above a lush Zhangjiajie-like canyon, showing courage, wonder and forward motion without portraying reckless danger.
items.altText: 两名旅行者小心穿过张家界风格峡谷上方的绳桥。

items.sentenceEn: The external pipes run along the outside wall of the building.
items.sentenceZh: 外部管道沿着建筑物的外墙铺设。
items.scene: A cutaway-like exterior view shows several bright utility pipes attached visibly to the outside face of a plain building, while the interior remains muted and pipe-free.
items.altText: 明亮的外部管道沿建筑外墙铺设，室内没有管道。

items.sentenceEn: The muddy footprints were proof that someone had entered the room.
items.sentenceZh: 泥脚印证明有人进入过这个房间。
items.scene: A careful investigator kneels beside a trail of muddy footprints leading from an open doorway into an otherwise spotless room, connecting the visible evidence to the unseen visitor.
items.altText: 调查者查看从门口延伸进房间的泥脚印证据。

items.sentenceEn: Nora felt confident as she stepped onto the stage.
items.sentenceZh: 诺拉走上舞台时感到很自信。
items.scene: An adult speaker walks onto a softly lit stage with upright posture, steady eyes and a warm assured smile while a diverse audience watches attentively from below.
items.altText: 诺拉以挺拔姿态和自信微笑走上舞台。

items.sentenceEn: The company's headquarters coordinates teams across the country.
items.sentenceZh: 公司总部协调全国各地的团队。
items.scene: A central office building in Shanghai connects through sweeping graphic lines to several small regional team scenes across a simplified map shape, emphasizing coordination from one hub.
items.altText: 上海的一座总部大楼连接并协调各地团队。

items.sentenceEn: A sudden gust sent every umbrella turning inside out.
items.sentenceZh: 一阵突如其来的强风把所有雨伞都吹翻了。
items.scene: On a rainy city sidewalk, a sharp gust bends nearby trees and flips three umbrellas inside out at the same instant, startling their adult owners with expressive faces.
items.altText: 突来的强风同时吹翻三把雨伞，行人露出惊讶表情。

items.sentenceEn: The children changed out of their dirty clothes after planting rice.
items.sentenceZh: 孩子们插秧后换下了沾满泥的脏衣服。
items.scene: At the edge of a green rice terrace, two older children in visibly mud-splashed work clothes wash their boots while clean folded clothes wait in a dry basket nearby.
items.altText: 稻田边，孩子们清洗泥靴，身上的劳动服沾满泥点。

items.sentenceEn: Parking across the emergency exit is a serious violation.
items.sentenceZh: 把车停在紧急出口前是严重的违规行为。
items.scene: A car blocks a clearly recognizable emergency doorway while a safety officer gestures toward the obstructed route and a second unobstructed doorway provides a visual comparison; use universal shapes without readable signs.
items.altText: 汽车堵住紧急出口，安全员指出这项严重违规。
